theorem source_linearization (e t : ℝ) (x : Vec) (i : Fin 6) :
    branchingField e (fun j => 1+t*x j) i =
    t*meanAction e x i + t^2/10*daughters x i

theorem source_mass (i : Fin 6) :
    daughters (fun _ => 1) i = 1 ∧ expectedDaughters (fun _ => 1) i = 2
theorem weight_bounds (i : Fin 6) : 10 ≤ weight i ∧ weight i ≤ 107

theorem source_contraction (e : ℝ) (lo : 29/100 ≤ e) (hi : e ≤ 31/100)
    (i : Fin 6) : meanAction e weight i ≤ -(9/100)*weight i

theorem source_ramp_growth (e : ℝ) (lo : 1/100 ≤ e) (hi : e ≤ 31/100)
    (i : Fin 6) : meanAction e weight i ≤ (14/100)*weight i

theorem source_hazard_domination (v k : ℝ) (hv : 0 ≤ v) (i : Fin 6) :
    deaths i+k ≤ 3/10+v+k
theorem clock_one : clockValue 1 = 13/138
theorem clock_two : clockValue 2 = 1618/4347

theorem exclusion_certificate :
    clockValue 2 + 20*(1/1000 : ℚ)*120/4 < 49/50

theorem logistic_cap (K h r : ℝ) (hK : 0 < K) (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    r*h*(1-h/K) ≤ K*r/4

theorem ten_step_excursion_product :
    (∏ j ∈ Finset.range 10, (20*(61/100 : ℚ)/12)/(j+1)) =
    (20*(61/100 : ℚ)/12)^10 / Nat.factorial 10
theorem reserve_certificate : 0 < reserveBound ∧ reserveBound < 1/2000

theorem exposure_repair_algebra (charge final initial repair integral cap T : ℝ)
    (hidentity : charge = final-initial+repair*integral)
    (hfinal : final ≤ cap) (hint : integral ≤ cap*T) (hr : 0 ≤ repair) :
    charge ≤ cap-initial+repair*cap*T

theorem perturbation_budget (e : ℝ) (_lo : 1/100 ≤ e) (hi : e ≤ 31/100)
    (i : Fin 6) : perturbationEnvelope e i ≤ weight i/1000

theorem exponential_lower_certificates :
    8000 < expLower 9 25 ∧ 50 < expLower (99/25) 15

    (∀ (e : ℝ), 29/100 ≤ e → e ≤ 31/100 →
      ∀ i, meanAction e weight i ≤ -(9/100)*weight i) ∧
    (clockValue 2 + 20*(1/1000 : ℚ)*120/4 < 49/50) ∧

    ((107/20000 : ℚ) < 1/100) ∧

      ∀ i, perturbationEnvelope e i ≤ weight i/1000) ∧
    (8000 < expLower 9 25 ∧ 50 < expLower (99/25) 15)
